name: Prism
description: The cicada: a singer of the brood, and the loud one. Long pale rose hair falling past the shoulders under a crown of rose crystal, both eyes closed and the mouth open — Prism is singing, and what comes out is the chirp: a hum thrown outward in a ring from the tymbal at the hip, drawn leaving it in the idle, faint and cold, because it is a sound and not a scent. A fitted slate robe with a faceted crystal breastplate, one plane lit and one in shade with a ridge between — the prism it used to be — a rose sash, and two long clear wings folded down the back from the shoulders like a cape. The feelers are held the widest apart on the roster, one thrown forward and one back: the survivor that finds things. Long light legs, because this is also the one that runs. Same dead organ as the rest, set in the breastplate. Drawn facing +x; the game flips it.

idle.description: a singer's stance: a lighter, quicker breath, the long hair and the folded wings stirring, the feelers sweeping wide; twice a cycle a ring of chirp leaves the tymbal at the hip, grows, and fades

walk.description: a bounding run on long legs: the highest bob of the eight, the hair and the wings lifting off the back on every push, the feelers streaming
